messages:
courtney_sales: Quick heads-up — Novabank POC asking for SOC2 artifacts + signed pen-test letter. They said "needed by EOW". Who can confirm minimum shareable set? @samir_security @olivia_ops :eyes:

alex_g: Short answer: they usually accept SOC2 summary + control excerpts and a pen-test attestation letter. Need legal sign-off on the letter format. How strict are we on sharing control narratives?

samir_security: We can't share full report. Offer: SOC2 Type II summary (scope + auditor statement), control matrix excerpts (relevant controls only), and redacted pen-test letter. Need to redact IP addresses/service accounts from any attachments.

olivia_ops: Ops can generate a sanitized network diagram and list of envs in-scope. ETA for sanitized bundle ~48h if we have approval on redaction rules.

courtney_sales: Great. Novabank also asked about dedicated pricing impact if they want onprem staging for the pen-test. Can we give a rough delta?

mike_eng: Rough ballpark: dedicated staging during POC adds ~20-30% to POC commitment (depends on GPUs/retention). I'll DM numbers but don't quote publicly.

samir_security: Legal wants a template for the pen-test letter. @legal-bot can you drop our standard attestation template and redaction checklist here?

legal-bot: Uploaded: /legal/templates/pen-test-attestation-template_v2.pdf and /legal/checklists/evidence-redaction-guidelines.md :white_check_mark:

courtney_sales: Perfect. Proposed next steps:
1) Ops prepares sanitized bundle (48h)
2) Security reviews redactions + signs off (24h)
3) Legal finalizes pen-test letter signature flow (24h)
4) Sales shares with Novabank and requests presigned upload link

alex_g: Adding: we should send presigned S3 upload with 7-day expiry, include contact for scanning window. Also ask Novabank to confirm whether they need IP-level diagrams (we should avoid sharing internal IPs).

samir_security: Agreed. Also include requirement that any third-party red-team provides a single-point PoC and agrees to our scanning window and nondisclosure terms.

olivia_ops: I'll start the sanitized bundle run — tagging @samir_security for redaction review. ETA updated: 36-48h depending on redaction comments.

courtney_sales: Thanks team. I'll update Novabank with provisional plan and timeline. If we hit blockers I'll escalate here. :thumbsup:
